Senior Product Manager - Enterprise Platform
Company: Orbis Software is a B2B SaaS company (Series C, 300 employees) providing workflow automation tools to mid-market and enterprise customers across financial services and healthcare, headquartered in Chicago, IL.

Location: Chicago, IL (Hybrid - 2 days/week on-site)
Compensation: $155,000 - $185,000 + equity

About the Role:
We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to own the core Enterprise Platform product area, which serves our 200+ largest customers. You will define the multi-year product vision, work daily with engineering and design, and maintain close relationships with key accounts and our enterprise sales organization.

Responsibilities:
- Define product strategy and multi-quarter roadmap for the Enterprise Platform, aligned to company OKRs
- Lead discovery, scoping, and prioritization for new platform capabilities through customer interviews and data analysis
- Partner with engineering and design leads to ship high-quality features on schedule
- Act as the voice of the customer in cross-functional forums including executive reviews
- Work with sales and customer success to develop go-to-market plans for major launches
- Define success metrics and monitor product performance post-launch using dashboards and qualitative signals

Requirements:
- 5+ years of product management experience, with at least 2 years on a B2B SaaS product (required)
- Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to write clear PRDs and present to C-suite (required)
- Experience managing a product roadmap and making data-informed prioritization decisions (required)
- Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams without direct authority (required)
- Comfort with product analytics tools (Amplitude, Mixpanel, or similar) and SQL for self-service data analysis (required)

Nice to have:
- Experience with workflow automation, BPM, or integration products
- Exposure to enterprise sales cycles and enterprise customer relationships
- MBA or other advanced degree
- Prior experience in financial services or healthcare technology
- Familiarity with API-first product design
